answer: One workable design: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because zenith only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, oasis is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any ocean approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
